device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC compact satellite receiver
device.soc: ALi C3503D (chip word 0x3503D000, SDK chip code 0x10051)

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, chip word 0x3503D000 -> SDK chip code 0x10051, run_dump_a54_v112b0_patch_app_starts.py, run_dump_a54_v112b0_patch_capture_screen.py): its boot-ROM bootloader at offset 0x800 runs in the boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800 ($sp = 0x9FE07F00), unpacks the 9.99 MB maincode (0x9fcdb0 bytes) into RAM and starts it at 0x80000200.  The internal S3501-class DVB-S2 demodulator answers at 0xB804C000 and the M3031 tuner answers at I2C 0x20.  Drives its external FD650K 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 24 (SCL) / 23 (SDA) through " On ", " on ", "nenu" and renders its 1280x720 "System Setup" OSD menu through GMA layer 0 at 0xB8006300.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 54 patched firmware V1.12B0_PATCH (2019-01-14) for the compact Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the single-CPU ALi C3503D SoC.
EMU/patch build of V1.12B0 (maincode chunk header tagged V1.12B0*, unpacked size 10,472,880 bytes).
